title: Remove change-of-variables axioms: use MeasureTheory.integral_image_eq_integral_abs_deriv_smul
description: The source proof area-of-circle-oq-01-oq-03-oq-01 (Arc-Length Reparametrization for Smooth Closed Curves) uses axiom declarations for change-of-variables steps in the circumference integral. Replace these with Mathlib's MeasureTheory.integral_image_eq_integral_abs_deriv_smul, which handles measure-preserving change of variables with absolute derivative. This continues the axiom-elimination pattern established by the LP duality synthesis.
